parts.name: sky
parts.desc: Full-width rectangle filled with a vertical linear gradient from #6fb3dd at the top to #fde7b0 near the bottom edge at y=420, forming a soft daytime sky behind everything.

parts.name: sun
parts.desc: Circle of radius 40 centered at (165,125) filled with a radial gradient from #fffaf0 at the center to #f6c453 at the edge, surrounded by a faint outer glow of rgba(246,196,83,0.25) extending to radius 55; sits in the upper-left sky.

parts.name: clouds
parts.desc: Two fluffy clouds in the upper-right sky, each built from 4-5 overlapping bezier-lobed puffs filled #fffaf0 with a subtle bottom shading of #fde7b0; one larger cloud around (420,100) and a smaller one around (640,140).

parts.name: far_mountains
parts.desc: Jagged mountain range silhouette drawn as a single closed path of irregular peaks rising to about y=210, filled with a vertical gradient from #7a8fb3 at the peaks to #a9b9cf at the base (y=440), with small #fffaf0 snowcaps on the two tallest peaks near x=260 and x=560.

parts.name: far_hills
parts.desc: Rolling hill band drawn with smooth bezier curves cresting around y=330-370, filled with a vertical gradient from #8cc063 at the top to #4f7a4a at the bottom (y=480); sits in front of the mountains.

parts.name: near_hills
parts.desc: Foreground meadow filling the bottom of the canvas, its top edge a gentle bezier wave between y=400 and y=440, filled with a vertical gradient from #4f7a4a at the crest to #2e4a3a at the bottom edge, with a lighter #8cc063 highlight along the upper-left crest.

parts.name: river
parts.desc: Winding river path that starts narrow near (470,385) between the far hills and widens as it curves down to the bottom edge between x=320 and x=600, drawn with mirrored bezier banks and filled with a vertical gradient from #bfe3f2 to #6fb3dd, plus a few thin #fffaf0 highlight streaks.

parts.name: trees
parts.desc: Cluster of three pine trees on the left foreground hill, each a stack of three overlapping bezier-curved triangular tiers filled #2e4a3a with lighter #4f7a4a left-side highlights, on short #6b4a2e trunks; tallest is about 180px high near x=120, base around y=510.

parts.name: flowers
parts.desc: Scattered small wildflowers in the lower-right meadow: about 15 tiny five-dot blossoms in #f6c453 and #fffaf0 with #fde7b0 centers, each on a short thin #8cc063 stem, spread loosely across the box.
